title: Technical reputation: talks, articles and community

videos.script: A technical reputation is what people expect of you when you are not in the room. {{title}} It does not come from saying good things about yourself. Engineers can tell, usually within one conversation. It comes from work other people could see. Every document in this course was, quietly, a piece of it. {{circles}} This lesson takes that record outside. An article, written only after asking what may be said. A talk, at a local meetup first, rehearsed until it is boring. {{talk}} Small contributions to the projects you depend on, with credit given to the people who did the work. {{credit}} And the line between teaching and selling. The audience should leave knowing more about the subject, not more about you.
